items.exampleEn: The city holds a naval parade by the harbor every October.
items.exampleZh: 這座城市每年十月都在港邊舉行海軍遊行。

items.exampleEn: In the film, the old bomber was painted silver and green.
items.exampleZh: 在那部電影裡，那架老轟炸機漆成銀色和綠色。

items.exampleEn: She tried to suppress a laugh during the serious meeting.
items.exampleZh: 她在嚴肅的會議中努力忍住不笑出來。

items.exampleEn: The new manager promised to cut down on bureaucracy in the company.
items.exampleZh: 新經理承諾要減少公司裡的官僚作風。

items.exampleEn: The man was prosecuted for selling fake concert tickets.
items.exampleZh: 那名男子因販賣假的演唱會門票而被起訴。

items.exampleEn: The new law must be approved by parliament before it takes effect.
items.exampleZh: 新法律在生效前必須經過國會通過。

items.exampleEn: The poet spent ten years in exile, far from his hometown.
items.exampleZh: 那位詩人流亡了十年，遠離家鄉。

items.exampleEn: The history book describes how guerrilla groups moved through the mountains at night.
items.exampleZh: 那本歷史書描述游擊隊如何在夜裡穿越山區。

items.sentenceEn: Napoleon was sent into exile on a small island.
items.sentenceZh: 拿破崙被放逐到一座小島上。

items.audioEn: The naval museum opens at nine, and the guided tour of the old ship starts at ten.
items.audioZh: 海軍博物館九點開門，老船的導覽十點開始。

items.sentenceEn: The singer could not suppress her tears when the crowd stood up.
items.sentenceZh: 觀眾起立時，那位歌手忍不住流下眼淚。

items.sentenceEn: Some small companies use guerrilla marketing to attract young customers.
items.sentenceZh: 有些小公司用游擊式行銷來吸引年輕顧客。

items.stemEn: The prime minister gave a long speech in ____ this morning.
items.stemZh: 總理今天早上在國會發表了一場很長的演說。

items.stemEn: The city decided to ____ the factory owner for dumping waste into the river.
items.stemZh: 市政府決定起訴那位把廢棄物倒進河裡的工廠老闆。

items.passageEn: On Saturday, I visited the naval museum by the harbor with my grandfather, who once served in the navy. The first hall shows models of famous ships from the last two hundred years. Outside, there is a real bomber, about eighty years old, that visitors can walk inside. My grandfather was most interested in a small room about life on board, with old menus from the ship's kitchen. Before we left, he bought me a book about ships at the gift shop.
items.passageZh: 星期六，我和曾在海軍服役的爺爺一起去參觀港邊的海軍博物館。第一個展廳展示過去兩百年來著名船艦的模型。館外有一架大約八十年歷史的真正轟炸機，參觀者可以走進去。爺爺最感興趣的是一個介紹船上生活的小展間，裡面有船上廚房的舊菜單。離開前，他在禮品店買了一本關於船的書給我。

options: 一架可以走進去的轟炸機

questions.questionZh: 爺爺最感興趣的是什麼？

items.promptZh: 她的祖父年輕時是一名海軍軍官。
referenceEn: Her grandfather was a naval officer when he was young.
When her grandfather was young, he was a naval officer.
rubricZh: 要用 naval 修飾名詞（例如 a naval officer）
「年輕時」可寫，例如 when he was young、in his youth 等
時態合理即可（例如 was、had been 等）

items.instructionZh: 用 bureaucracy 造一個句子，說說你辦事時遇到繁瑣手續的經驗。
referenceEn: I waited three hours at the city office because of all the bureaucracy.
There was so much bureaucracy that I almost gave up on my visa.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 bureaucracy（例如 all the bureaucracy、so much bureaucracy）
時態配合內容（例如 waited、was 等）
